timeline: Lin Shu-zhen blackmails Lin Wei with her mother's surgery to force her into a contract marriage with Adrian Vale.
Lin Wei receives a critical condition update from Dr. Kieran Lowe.
Lin Wei arrives at Han Corporation headquarters to meet Adrian Vale.
Lin Wei meets Adrian Vale in his office.
Adrian Vale presents the contract and reinforces the non-negotiable nature of Article 7.
Lin Wei challenges Adrian on his choice of her as a candidate, noting his subtle reaction.
In Adrian Vale's office, Lin Wei recalls Dr. Kieran Lowe warning that her mother has forty-eight hours without experimental treatment.
Adrian states the core terms as one year, legal marriage, and compliance.
Lin Wei probes why Adrian wants a journalist involved in his social architecture.
Adrian says journalists require containment but that Lin Wei's unique perspective is precisely what is required.
Adrian frames Lin Wei's mother's condition as leverage.
Lin Wei arrives at the Vale estate with a single suitcase and recognizes the house as a form of confinement rather than hospitality.
Lin Wei assesses the estate foyer for exit points, security cameras, and approaching footsteps while touching the jade pendant hidden beneath her blouse.
Adrian confronts Lin Wei for arriving late and reiterates that their life in the house will operate by contract rather than emotion.
Adrian leads Lin Wei into his study instead of giving her a tour.
Adrian tells Lin Wei that her mother's medical reports are on his desk, that Mercy General specialists have taken over the case, and that the first payment has cleared.
Lin Wei reaches for the medical reports, but Adrian grips her wrist and orders her to read them later.
